digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Multiple gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard-fail (exit code 2) when the script is absent from the checked-out tree.
Gerrit's Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the patchset's tree, so steps added on main fail against older changes whose base predates the script.
Nine unguarded steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job must skip with a log line when their respective scripts are absent.
Each guarded step must both skip cleanly (exit 0, no ::error:: annotation) when the script is missing and still fail the build when the script is present and reports a gate violation.
A structural guard in the CI workflow prevents future instances by detecting and failing on any step running a repo script without the if-present guard in patchset-checkout jobs.
